subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Shelby Cobra
description: A fast breakdown of The Shelby Cobra for builders.

hook.text: Carroll Shelby stuffed a massive Ford V8 into a tiny British sports car. The result was terrifying.

buildup.text: The AC Ace was a lightweight roadster. Ford's 289 V8 gave it a power-to-weight ratio that was insane.

discovery.text: The Cobra could outrun Ferraris and Corvettes costing twice as much—raw American power in a British shell.

twist.text: Shelby was a chicken farmer and ex-race driver with a heart condition. Nobody expected him to succeed.

climax.text: Original Cobras now sell for millions. Replicas outnumber originals by at least fifty to one.

punchline.text: A farmer built one of the most valuable cars ever.

quiz.question: What was Carroll Shelby's background before cars?
